boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places for studying, reflecting, gathering, making, and seeing art—each supported by a direct University of Richmond source.

cards.title: Boatwright Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: 261 Richmond Way
cards.notes: Choose a study zone that fits the task, then use the library’s services desk, course reserves, lockers, and technology resources as needed.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines study zones with research and academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Boatwright offers library study zones, course reserves, lockers, scanning and printing, and other library services.
cards.access_notes: Building hours and access can change; consult the library’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Galvin Rare Book Room
cards.subtitle: Boatwright Library, level B-1
cards.notes: Bring a research question and ask staff how to work with primary sources, including books, maps, manuscripts, photographs, and music scores.
cards.short_summary: A primary-source research room within Boatwright Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Galvin Rare Book Room houses rare books, broadsides, manuscripts, maps, newspapers, music scores, facsimiles, and photographs for researchers.
cards.source_title: Book Arts, Archives, and Rare Books | Boatwright Library
cards.access_notes: Ask Book Arts, Archives, and Rare Books staff about access and handling procedures before a visit.

cards.title: Lora Robins Gallery
cards.subtitle: Ground floor, Boatwright Memorial Library
cards.notes: Plan a short gallery stop around a library visit and check the museum page for reopening dates and current hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A natural-science gallery with fossils, minerals, shells, and other objects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lora Robins Gallery is a University Museums location in Boatwright Library, and museum admission is always free.
cards.access_notes: The museum’s visit page says the gallery is closed for summer break and reopens at the start of fall 2026 semester; verify hours.

cards.entity_name: Joel and Lila Harnett Museum of Art
cards.title: Harnett Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Modlin Center for the Arts, 453 Westhampton Way
cards.notes: Use the museum’s exhibition calendar to pair a gallery visit with a talk, opening, workshop, or a self-guided look at the current show.
cards.short_summary: The University’s art museum is located inside the Modlin Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Harnett Museum is part of University of Richmond Museums; admission to it and its Print Study Center is always free.
cards.access_notes: The visit page lists a summer closure; check current exhibition and opening information before visiting.

cards.title: Cannon Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: 410 Westhampton Way
cards.notes: Check the Chaplaincy or Music calendar, then attend a service, lecture, recital, or other scheduled campus gathering in this historic space.
cards.short_summary: A central campus chapel used for reflection, worship, music, and academic occasions.
cards.evidence_claim: Cannon Memorial Chapel is used for religious services, cultural events, academic assemblies, and honors convocations.
cards.source_title: Cannon Memorial Chapel | University of Richmond Chaplaincy
cards.access_notes: The chapel is a priority-use facility; access and event attendance depend on its schedule.

cards.title: Tyler Haynes Commons
cards.subtitle: Central campus student center
cards.notes: Meet a classmate for a meal, a game, or a campus event, and use the information desk to orient yourself to the building’s student resources.
cards.short_summary: A student-life hub with dining, games, events, and campus offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Involvement describes Tyler Haynes Commons as a central hub where students can hang out, grab a meal, play games, or attend an event.
cards.source_title: Student Centers | Center for Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: University One Card Services lists public building hours as daily 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; affiliated users have 24/7 swipe access.

cards.title: The Web Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Activities Complex
cards.notes: If you are planning a registered student-organization meeting or event, ask Student Involvement about the Web Lounge and its reservation process.
cards.short_summary: A student-centered venue in the Student Activities Complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The Web Lounge is listed by Student Involvement among campus student spaces, where hundreds of student-organization meetings and events occur each year.
cards.source_title: Student Centers | Center for Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: These student spaces are reserved for registered student organizations and are managed by the Center for Student Involvement.

cards.title: Jenkins Greek Theatre
cards.subtitle: Outdoor campus venue
cards.notes: Look for an organization program scheduled in the amphitheater, or coordinate with Student Involvement if your registered group needs an outdoor event site.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor venue available through campus event planning.
cards.evidence_claim: The University’s reservable-spaces guidance lists the Greek Theatre as an outdoor venue with a capacity of 300.
cards.source_title: RSO Reservable Spaces | University of Richmond Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: The University notes that the Greek Theatre is not ADA accessible and has no bathrooms; event reservations should include a rain plan.

cards.title: Meditation Garden
cards.subtitle: First floor, Well-Being Center
cards.notes: Take a quiet break by the river rocks or use a meditation booth between classes; keep the space calm and leave it ready for the next visitor.
cards.short_summary: A designated mindfulness and relaxation area inside the Well-Being Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Well-Being Center’s Meditation Garden provides river rocks and meditation booths for mindfulness and relaxation.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor behind the Well-Being Center welcome desk; confirm building access before visiting.

cards.title: Westhampton Lake
cards.subtitle: Central campus lake and pathways
cards.notes: Use the lakeside paths for a calm between-class walk, and cross the connecting bridges to move between the Richmond and Westhampton sides of campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus focal point with paths and bridges linking both sides of the University.
cards.evidence_claim: The University’s campus plan identifies Westhampton Lake as a scenic focal point, with pathways and bridges linking the Richmond and Westhampton sides.
cards.access_notes: Use marked pathways and observe any campus notices or temporary access restrictions.
